purpose: Evidence-qualified multi-target goal continuity through native-Sims autonomous distractions; no new daemon or game input

input.targets: 1..32 unique stable plant/object references with PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, VERIFIED_DONE; each VERIFIED_DONE must have outcome_ref and outcome_capture_ref
input.queue: 0..24 bounded current Sim queue rows; origin needs origin_proof_ref for positive attribution

invariants: Never cancel or override a player command or a currently queued task
Do not turn ordinary queue labels into proof of SIM_AUTONOMY origin
Do not infer fertilization success from a dispatched click or absence from queue
Resume only the first pending target with a fresh observed exact-target affordance
Urgent needs, obligations, player presence, scene and screen_admit retain higher authority
No repeated resubmission, arbitrary background loop, or user save edits
